title: Register and Tone
rule: C2 writers control tone: neutral, critical, diplomatic, or ironic.

examples.text: The proposal is, to put it mildly, ambitious.
I am compelled to dissent from this view.
The claim is not entirely unfounded.
With respect, that argument overlooks key facts.
The outcome was predictable, if disappointing.

practicePrompt: Complete: Diplomatic tone: 'You're wrong.' → 'I ___ a different interpretation.'
